declaration.intent: Specify the Build Loop step-spec: the schema for a single build step (action, target, acceptance, on_fail) and the README authoring format a step-spec is hand-written in. Phase 0 of Build Loop — no interpreter exists yet; this capsule pins the spec the interpreter will be built against. v2 replaces the unsigned v1, which never passed the schema gate (underscores in its scp_id), named its document by a path that did not resolve, and was never frozen.
